title: The Day You Were Born Is Named After a Planet

segments.text: The day of the week you were born is secretly named after a planet.
Ancient astrologers gave each day to a planet. And English never forgot.
Sunday is the Sun's day. You were born to be seen.
Monday belongs to the Moon. You feel everything first.
Tuesday is Tiw's day, a god of war. That's Mars. You're braver than you know.
Wednesday is Woden's day. That's Mercury. Your words open doors.
Thursday is Thor's day. That's Jupiter, planet of luck. It follows you.
Friday is Frigg's day. That's Venus. People fall for your softness.
Saturday still carries Saturn's name. Slow, steady, unbreakable.
Which day were you born? Tell me below, and send this to someone born on yours.
